source.method: Source ARPAbet to broad American IPA; material hints only select existing source variants. Multiword entries concatenate source citation forms.

US.reason: Uppercase US denotes the United States abbreviation, distinct from the pronoun us.

notes: Missing source pronunciations remain blank in the course dictionary until a separately labelled American lookup supplies them.
Phrase entries are independent source citation forms, not a connected-speech phonetic transcription.
Only source variants are emitted; legacy British hints are normalized for matching, never used to manufacture an American transcription.
